Commentary.Commentary: 290 to win then. This will be the highest successful ODI run chase at this venue, if it does happen. But the pitch seems to have flattened out, without much turn. We might be in for a good chase. Stay tuned.

Not the best bit of bowling from Sri Lanka and not the best piece of captaincy from Dimuth Karunaratne either. Thisara Perera was their best bowler but he bowled just 7 overs. Nuwan Pradeep was excellent while Wanindu Hasaranga was economical. But the Lankans struggled for wickets in the middle overs and their backup bowlers were ineffective. Isuru Udana had a poor day, going for 82 in his 10 overs, albeit getting 3 wickets towards the end.

A very good total posted by the visitors. It always helps when someone in the top 3 bats for long and Shai Hope's presence till the 46th over gave their hitters a good platform. His 115 was slow but measured, on a track which was doing something. He found able allies in Darren Bravo and Roston Chase, not letting the momentum get away. Towards the end, it seemed like the Windies were losing their way but Keemo Paul's cameo of an unbeaten 32 from 17 balls took the total close to 300.

Roston Chase is down for a chat with Roshan Abeysinghe. Chase says that the par score at this ground is 270, so they were targetting close to 300. Is happy with the total. Admits that Shai Hope set it up nicely for a big finish but they lost their way a bit, albeit their big hitters got a late flourish. On his own batting, Chase says that the ball was coming onto the wicket nicely, so he was just trying to play through the line and rotate the strike.
Full toss on middle, powered down to long on. There is a bit of a fumble by Thisara Perera but it only results in a couple of runs. WEST INDIES FINISH ON 289/7!
FOUR! This is some sort of finish by the Windies. A full ball on middle, Paul brings out the helicopter shot and whips it through mid-wicket!
FOUR! Terrific batting. A short ball, around middle, Paul heaves this through mid-wicket. The ball races to the fence!
A slower bouncer this time, Hayden looks to pull but misses. The batsmen run a quick bye.

FOUR! Ahhh... just about gets it in the end. Walsh jumps across to the off side, looks to paddle but the bowler spots that and slows the pace. However, in spite of being through the shot, Walsh manages to get the toe end of his bat to the ball and gets it past short fine leg!
Full and wide outside off, slapped to wide long off for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total. 13 from the over as Thisara finishes with figures of 7-1-40-1.
Outside off, driven through mid off for a couple.
SIX! That is a good hit. A length ball, around leg, Walsh backs away to the leg side and lofts it straight back down the ground!
Excellent yorker, outside off, back to the bowler.
Outside off, driven straight to cover. There is a mix-up but there is a fumble and the single is completed with ease.
Full on middle, rather, a low full toss. Bunted down the ground for a couple.
Thisara Perera to bowl the 49th over. 6-1-27-1 so far. Underbowled.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Walsh throws his bat at it and gets it to the left of short third man! 17 from the over.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.

FOUR! Fine shot. A length ball, on middle, Paul gets across and just helps it through mid-wicket. Once the ball hits the turf, it just races away. Dhananjaya de Silva charges across to his right in the deep and dives but in vain.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Full and wide outside off, Paul swings hard but misses.
SIX! SMOKED! This lad can bat. A length ball, around middle, Paul gets down on a knee and slogs it over mid-wicket!
Full on middle, driven through mid on for a couple.
Full and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a quick single.
Hayden Walsh walks in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! Disaster for the term called communication. A slower full toss, around middle, Holder looks to flick but is deceived by the lack of pace. The ball flies off the leading edge over the bowler, but lands in no man's land. Here is the surprise part though. The batsmen take the first and then turn for the second. Keemo Paul even come halfway down but then sees Angelo Mathews release the ball from long off. The throw is a limp one, which bounces, bounces and bounces but Paul stops and so does Holder, exactly in the middle of the pitch. Pradeep moves away from the throw and to Holder's frustration, the throw hits the stumps! The batsmen have not crossed for the second, so Holder has to depart.
Outside off, a swing and a miss.
FOUR! CLASSY! Long levers from Holder. Full and outside off, Holder reaches out and drives it through the covers. Long off rushes to his left and slides but in vain.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
On a good length around off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
WIDE! A slower bouncer outside off, Paul looks to pull but then bails out.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

FOUR! No hat-trick for Udana. He was on a hat-trick, as he had dismissed Pollard and Hope in successive deliveries. A short ball, around middle, Paul looks to pull but gets a top edge. That, though, flies over the keeper to the fence behind.
Keemo Paul comes out for some free hits now. He can hit the ball long and hard. Udana is on a hat-trick...

OUT! BOWLED! There goes the sixth wicket, but in a comical fashion. A full toss, around middle and leg, Hope gets across and looks to paddle. But he misses. The ball loops in onto him, beats his bat, hits his front pad, then the back pad and then rolls onto the stumps. Hope looks disappointed. He was just looking to break free. But a wonderful innings.
FOUR! Clean hitting. A length ball outside off, Holder backs away to the leg side, reaches out, using his long extension and carves it over covers!
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full again, eased through mid on for a run.
Full on middle, pushed through long on for a single.
The batsman swung at the ball and completely missed it.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Works this through mid-wicket for one more.
Driven towards the long on region. They pick up a single.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR MORE! Excellent use of the feet. Sandakan flights this around middle, Hope comes down the track and swings it wide of long on again!
FOUR! Short and around middle, Hope rocks back and pulls it wide of long on. Thisara Perera races to his right and dives but in vain.
Another single to end the over! On middle, Hope flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, this is nicely flicked through mid-wicket and two is taken.
A slower full ball, Hope drives but straight to covers.
A quick run! On off, Hope drops it towards point and takes one quickly.
On off, it is kept out.

100 for Hope! A really good ton. He was given out on the second ball and a review saved him. There was no looking back from then. He though knows he needs to stay out there till the end. He gets there by working this around the corner.
Nuwan Pradeep is back!
Jason Holder walks out to bat.

OUT! In the air... taken! Udana has picked two huge wickets and now the Windies are in a spot of bother here. They are losing their way towards the end. A good short one, this one is a seam-up delivery. Pollard is hurried into the pull. He gets a top edge which goes high up in the air towards fine leg. Sandakan takes a good catch. The Windies skipper fails to make an impact.
He moves onto 99 as he works this down to fine leg for one.
Another dot! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket.
One more slower one, this is worked back towards the bowler.
On the shorter side, Pollard pulls it down towards fine leg for one.
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
SIX! That is a long, long way! This is right in the zone for Pollard. It is full and on off, Pollard lofts it over the long off fence. Once again the last ball spoils the over.
On middle, it is kept out.
Flatter and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is hit to the left of the bowler who dives and stops it.
Gives it a lot of flight and lands it outside off, Pollard hits it down to long on for one.
Loopy ball on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 50th over.
A single to end Powerplay 2! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
One more slower one, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
A nasty delivery to welcome the opposition skipper. A bumper at a good pace. Pollard looks to fend it. It hits the glove and rolls on the leg side for one.
Kieron Pollard walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! A soft dismissal and this is big wicket. We all know how destructive Pooran can be but he falls well before he actually started to accelerate. A slower one from Udana. It is on a length and around off. Pooran looks to stroke it on the up but does so uppishy and it goes straight to Karunaratne there. A much-needed wicket for Udana. He has not been at his best but this will make him feel really good.
A slower bumper, it is pulled through square leg for one.
A full toss on the pads, Pooran works it towards mid-wicket. The fielder there dives to his right, gets a hand to it. It goes down towards mid on for one.
WIDE! Way too wide outside off, it is the slower one. Did not come off right.
A single to end so just the 4 from the over! The reverse sweep is out but it is not timed that well. A single through point.
One more dot as this is hit nicely but straight to mid off.
On off, this is pushed to the right of the bowler. He does well to dive and stop it.
On the pads, this is swept behind square on the leg side. Perera in the deep does well to keep it down to two.
Loopy ball on middle, this is eased towards the bowler who gets a hand to it. He deflects it towards mid off. No runs taken.
Floats it on the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Lovely shot to end a very good over for the Windies! This is hit o the up. Length and around off, Pooran strokes it through covers and bags another boundary.
Now a single as this is guided down to third man.

FOUR! Releases the little pressure that was building! Shorter and around off, Hope cuts it through point and it races away to the fence. A little bit of width offered and Hope is too good to miss out.
Just outside off, Hope looks to cut but gets an outside edge. It does not carry to the keeper. Two dots. This is a good passage of play for Lanka.
A good slower one on middle, Hope works it towards mid-wicket.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Isuru Udana is back! 4-0-27-0 so far for him.
On the pads, this is swept through square leg for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Outside off, it is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, Pooran pulls it through square leg for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Shorter and around off, this is cut towards point.
Nicholas Pooran is the new man in.

OUT! Plays it on! End of the stand that was really looking at ease out there. Sri Lanka will be pretty relieved they have got the breakthrough. Pradeep is the man to have provided it. A good slower one outside off, Chase looks to loft it over mid off but does so away from his body. He gets an inside edge onto the stumps. A good little innings from Chase comes to an end.
Fuller and on off, it is driven towards mid off.
Well fielded! Outside off, this is carved out towards deep backward point. Third man gets across quickly and keeps it down to one.
Well bowled! Chase comes down the track and Pradeep bowls a yorker. Chase mistimes it towards mid off.
Fuller and on off, it is stroked towards mid off.
Leading edge but it goes just over! On middle, Hope looks to flick but closes the face of the bat a little too early. A leading edge is induced which goes over the cover fielder for one.

FOUR! Once again the last ball costs a boundary! Poor finish to the over. A short ball, it sits up to be hit. Chase rocks back and pulls it well over the mid-wicket fielder. It lands just short of the ropes. A boundary.
Very full and on leg stump, Chase looks to whip it but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Hope wants a run but is sent back.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for one.
Hasaranga is back!
On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side for a single. 8 runs from this over.
Outside off, this is eased through covers for one.
Full and outside off, Chase goes after it with no foot movement. He gets beaten.

FOUR! Another boundary! So they are managing to get a boundary in almost every over. This is short and on middle, Chase pulls it. He is not in control of it but gets it over mid-wicket and it races away.
On the shorter side and on the body, this is pulled towards fine leg for one.
Quick single! Back of a length and on middle, Chase pushes it towards mid on for one. So they are not only scoring boundaries right now, the running between the wickets is also good.
FOUR! Spoils the over completely! Hope comes down the track and gets to the pitch of it this time. He lofts it over the bowler's head and bags a boundary.
Another single as this is hit down to long on.
Full and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
On middle, this is kept out.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Hope comes down the track and works it wide of long on for one.
Length delivery around off, Hope strokes it to mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, Hope runs it down to third man for a single.
Bouncer! Hope sits under it.
Fuller on off, Hope pushes it to mid off.
Length delivery on off, Hope once again glances it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball around off, Hope flicks it to mid-wicket.
Nuwan Pradeep is back!
One more singe as Hope works it down to long on. Back-to-back good overs for the visitors.
Follows the biggie with a single as this is worked through mid-wicket. Good batting.

SIX! Up and over! Top, top shot that. Boundaries leaking at the moment. Sandakan floats it up and lands it full outside off. Chase lifts it over covers. The connection is brilliant and it goes all the way.
Very full on the pads, Chase looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
On off, this is hit to covers.
Hope makes excellent use of the feet and strokes it towards long off. The fielder fumbles but only one run.
Lakshan Sandakan is back on!
A single to end but a top over for the Windies. One which can probably change the momentum of the game. 11 from it. Full and on off, it is driven through covers.
FOUR! Excellently pulled! Second boundary in the over. Short and on middle, Hope rocks back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket. No chance of stopping that.
Outside off, this is driven through point for one.
Slightly short on middle, Chase pulls but straight to mid-wicket.
Outside off, this is driven through covers for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Welcome back into the attack, Perera! It is full and on off, Hope lofts it over mid off and bags a boundary. Hope will probably be more comfortable with pace on the ball now.
Loopy ball on middle, Hope looks to play it with a straight bat but it goes off the outer half through covers for one.
Another single as another ball is flicked through square leg.
Fires it on middle, Hope works it through mid-wicket for one.
Very full and on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Quicker and flatter on middle, Chase looks to flick but closes the face of the bat a touch early. A soft leading edge is produced towards covers.
Loopy ball on off, this is eased down to mid off.
Couple! Slightly shorter and around off, Hope cuts it through point and two is taken.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Loopy ball on off, this is eased down to long off for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Nice shot! Brings out the reverse sweep. Hits it nice and fine. the fielder at short third man chases it down. Two taken.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
This is worked against the angle through square leg for one.
On middle, this is hit back to the bowler.
Comes down the track and then strokes it to long on for one.
Flatter and on off, it is kept out.
A full toss, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Very full and on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Dhananjaya de Silva is on.

Another lovely shot but only for two! Floats it up on off, Chase creams it through covers. The fielder at deep cover runs to his right, dives and saves two for his side. A good over this for the Windies.
FOUR! A lovely shot and a welcome boundary for the visitors! This is a little too full around off, Chase reaches out for it and strokes it through covers for a boundary.
On middle, Chase defends it onto the ground.
Shorter and around off, Hope pushes it through covers for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Fifty for Hope! A good innings by him so far but he needs to go on and also up the ante a touch. He gets there by pushing it down to long on for one.
A dot to end! On middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
Another single as Hope comes down the track and strokes it wide of the fielder at mid off.
Gets away with one there! A very short ball on middle, Chase goes back and pulls it hard but straight towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Just the one. 100 up for the Windies.
On middle, Hope pushes it down to long on and gets to the other end.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg, it is in the gap and two runs is taken.
Gives it a lot of air, Chase strokes it down to long on for one.
A maiden! Brilliant! This is floated up on off, Hope strokes it to the left of the bowler who dives and saves a run.
5 dots in a row now as another ball is defended.
4 dots in a row! On middle, Hope pushes it towards cover.
Another dot as this is kept out nicely.
On middle, blocked.
Good fielding! Flatter and on middle, this is pushed beside the pitch. The fielder at mid-wicket dives to his left and saves a run.
Shorter in length and outside off, this slapped through covers for one.
Chase comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He hits it  towards mid off.
An easy single this time as he strokes it through covers. Runs very hard to come by at the moment.
Gives it a lot of air and bowls it outside off, Chase looks to go too hard but mistimes it towards mid off.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket.
The googly on middle, Chase goes back and tries to defend but it goes off the outer half towards point.
On the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
Another single as Chase eases this down to the long off fielder.
Loopy ball on off, it is eased down to long off for a single.
Floats it up on middle, it is defended.
On the shorter side and on middle, Chase pushes it past the bowler for one.
Outside off, Hope slaps it through covers for one.
Uses his feet again and eases it down to long on for one. Another tight over comes to an end.
Hope comes down the track and strokes it to mid off for another dot.
Gives it air and lands it on middle, defended.
Chase is off the mark! On middle, it stays a touch low. Chase works it through mid-wicket for one.
Another tossed up ball around off, Chase drives but straight to covers.
Very full and on off, it is jammed back towards the bowler.
Shorter and flatter on middle and off, Hope blocks it.
Flighted on off, Hope pushes it to cover.
Roston Chase walks out to bat.

OUT! Run Out! Confusion and it leads to the downfall of Darren Bravo. The partnership was going very strongly but unfortunately it cannot last any longer. Flighted delivery on off, Hope defends it towards cover and calls for a run. Darren Bravo quickly responds but Hope then turns his back. Bravo is too far down the track and his hopes of going back safely is unrealistic one as Kusal Mendis quickly gets to the ball and sends a decent throw to Wanindu at the bowler's end. Hasaranga does the rest. Bravo's dive is not enough to save him and he cannot believe it. He takes his time to get back up and starts taking the heavy step back.
Darted on the pads, Hope flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, Shai defends it off the front foot.
Floated on off, Hope pushes it back to the bowler.

A direct hit! It has been referred upstairs. NOT OUT! Bravo is well in. It is on off, Hope pushes it towards cover and sets off. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the striker's end. An appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and they show that Bravo is in by a mile.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Floats it up on off, this is hit towards covers.
A full toss on middle, Hope strokes it back towards the bowler. He misfields and a run is taken.
On middle, it is kept out.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full and wide outside off, Hope reaches out for it and strokes it through covers for a boundary.
A single to end a tight first by the leggie. This is floated on off, it is driven through covers for one.
Gives it a nice loop and lands it on middle, defended.
Shorter and on off, Hope pushes it back to the bowler. There is a little assistance for the spinner.
Plays the sweep shot now towards deep backward square leg for one.
This one is down the leg side, Bravo looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Flighted ball on off, it is kept out.
On off, Bravo keeps it out.
Wanindu Hasaranga is on now!
Shorter and outside off, it is slapped through covers for one.
WIDE! Very slow but a little too wide outside off. It is left alone.
A full toss, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Loopy ball on off, Hope comes down the track and hits it nicely but straight to mid off.
Shorter and around off, it is pushed towards the bowler.
Loopy ball on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
A full toss, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
Lakshan Sandakan is on now!
DRINKS!
Another delivery outside off, it is left alone.
Again on the off pole, it is guided to point.
Outside off again, it is left alone.
BEATEN! This is a length ball outside off, Bravo looks to push at it but does so outside the line. He gets beaten.
Outside off, it is left alone.
Shorter and around off, Bravo pushes it through point. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, slides and keeps it down to two.
FOUR! Badly lined. Down the leg side, flicked through fine leg for a boundary!
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full on middle, driven towards mid on.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Well outside off, left alone.
Around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. 50-RUN STAND IS UP! Good recovery.
Works this through square leg for a single.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad. The fielding side are asking the question. They pick up a single. Leg bye given by the umpire.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Full and around off, well defended.
Excellent running. Hope works this through mid-wicket and runs hard to come back for the third. The third run was taken on the throw.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Landed outside off, left alone. 11 from Mathews' first over, 23 from the last 2!

SIX! Ho ho ho! Beautiful batting. Bravo is making sure that Mathews continues to bowl only once in a blue moon. He is not going to allow the bowler to settle. A length ball, outside off, Bravo lofts this as straight as an arrow, over the sightscreen!
FOUR! Clean hitting! Full and wide outside off, Bravo lofts this over the fielder at mid off and sends the ball packing to the boundary!
Landed outside off, a flirt and a miss.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full and around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Angelo Mathews is about to bowl. Things that usually happen once in a blue moon these days, thanks to his recurring injuries.
Full and around off, worked through mid-wicket for one. 12 from the over.
Works this through mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! Up, up and away! So Laraesque. Full and outside off, Bravo lofts this as straight as an arrow, clean as a whistle, right over the sightscreen!
Gets across his stumps and looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. There is a mild appeal for LBW but it is not entertained. A leg bye taken.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
A length ball, around off, coming back in, tucked through mid-wicket for three runs.
POWERPLAY 2 time. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Outside off, on a length, Hope looks to feel for it but misses.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
A length ball, down the leg side, Bravo looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. A leg bye taken.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Landed outside off, played through point for a single.
Landed outside off, coming in with the angle, left alone.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side.
A length ball outside off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! CLASSY! Full and wide outside off, Bravo leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
On a length outside off, punched through the covers but straight to cover.
Isuru Udana into the attack now.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
On middle, tucked through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! A length ball, outside off, Bravo punches it over cover for a boundary!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, pushed straight to mid on.
Full and wide outside off, swinging away, left alone.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Wristy work. A length ball, around off, Hope gets across and maneuvers it wide of mid on and finds the boundary! Just the second in the innings.
Around off, pushed towards cover.
Full and outside off, Bravo drives this on the up and gets it behind point for a single.
Landed around off, watchfully blocked out.
Full and outside off, pushed uppishly towards mid off.
That is a beauty. A length ball, outside off, Shai looks to defend but the ball kicks up after pitching and moves past the outside edge.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Full and straight, Hope gets across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, Bravo gets across and defends.
Fuller in length, watchfully blocked out.
Around off, solidly defended.

Good fielding but then misjudgement. Full and outside off, Hope drives this straight down the ground. Isuru Udana covers good ground to his right and dives, making a good stop. But then... he tries throwing it to the fielder from mid on who has overrun the throw! Now, the batsmen take a single. Isuru is not happy with the fielder.
A length ball around off, solidly defended.

Great fielding. A length ball, outside off, Bravo punches this through the covers, calls for a single but Wanindu Hasaranga dives to his right and sends the batsmen back to their respective positions. WICKET MAIDEN FOR THISARA!
Full and outside off, angling away, left alone.
Outside off, this is punched off the back foot.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Darren Bravo walks in at number 3, replacing Ambris. After a long time, eh?

OUT! BOWLED! Thisara has struck with one of the new balls. A length ball, around off, coming in with the angle, Ambris looks to flick but falls over in his followthrough. The ball jags back in, surprising Sunil, makes him play away from his body, beats the bat, hits the pad and cannons into the middle stump. Early strike for Sri Lanka.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Around off, worked towards mid-wicket for a quick single. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but the batsman is well in.
Full and outside off, left alone.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a length, around off, coming in with the angle, tucked through square leg for a couple. Both openers are off the mark now.
Full and around off, better from Sunil, as he defends.
Landed outside off, not a smart shot played by Ambris as he plays a loose drive. Misses.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, no swing whatsoever, driven wide of mid off for a couple.
Full again, watchfully defended.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Full and outside off, pretty wide, left alone.
FOUR! CARESSED! Welcome, Thisara. Overpitched, wide outside off, Hope leans and drives it between cover and point.
Thisara Perera to bowl with the second new ball.
Full and straight, Ambris plays across the line, is a bit early and gets a leading edge to cover. A fiery opening over from Pradeep.
Landed outside off, on a length, let through.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total. The scoreboard is underway.
Full and outside off, swinging away, left alone.

NOT OUT! The decision is overturned. Full and straight, Hope looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Pradeep appeals and after thinking for a while, the umpire raises his finger. Hope looks at Ambris but gets nothing. Then he furiously asks him to reply something. Now, Ambris timidly says yes and the review is taken. Ball Tracker shows it to be missing leg stump!

OUT! LBW! Shai Hope has been adjudged LBW. He is furiously asking his partner whether to take the review or not and after an eternity, a timid Ambris says yes! We go upstairs... Ball Tracker shows it to be missing leg stump!
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.

Namo, Namo, Namo Maathaa is done and we are ready for the game to begin. The Lankan players are in a huddle. Now, they disperse. Out come the Windies openers - Shai Hope and Sunil Ambris. Nuwan Pradeep to start off proceedings to Hope. Here we go. 'Play!' says Ruchira Palliyaguruge.
Time for the national anthems. 'Rally 'round the West Indies' first up.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Dimuth Karunaratne (C), Avishka Fernando, Kusal Perera (WK), Kusal Mendis, Angelo Mathews, Dhananjaya de Silva, Thisara Perera, Wanindu Hasaranga, Isuru Udana, Lakshan Sandakan and Nuwan Pradeep.
West Indies (Playing XI) - Sunil Ambris, Shai Hope (WK), Darren Bravo, Roston Chase, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard(C), Jason Holder, Hayden Walsh, Keemo Paul, Alzarri Joseph and Sheldon Cottrell.

West Indian captain, Kieron Pollard too, wanted to bowl first. But adds that the team came here prepared to do whatever it is asked to. On the team combination, Polly says that they are going in with 4 seamers and 2 spinners, which makes it a balanced attack. Is excited to lead this unit and says that it is all about finding one's identity.

Sri Lankan skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne, says that the SSC wicket has something for the fast bowlers in the first few overs, hence the decision. Informs that they are going in with 2 spinners and an all-rounder. Adds that the batters and the bowlers are in good shape and this is the time to show the talent.

TOSS - Time for the spin of the coin. Tails is the call from Pollard, but Heads it is. SRI LANKA HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO CHASE. Interesting. Chasing in a day game. Early morning moisture influencing the decision?

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold observes the surface and sees a lot more grass than what is seen in the whole of Sri Lanka. Expects a little bit of pace and bounce, the ball should carry through and the batsmen should be able to hit through the line.
WEATHER - Most important question. How is the weather? Is it raining? NO! Bright and sunny. Is there any rain forecast? Cannot forecast about the weather in Sri Lanka.

Namaaskaaraaa Sri Lanka!!! A Saturday morning and a day of cricket. Any better way to celebrate the weekend? Well, late bloomers might argue. But cricket lovers will love February the 22nd. New Zealand fighting against India. Zimbabwe playing at second home, Bangladesh. West Indies challenging Sri Lanka. Then two Women's World T20 matches to follow. Let the cricket begin! Hello and a warm welcome to the first ODI between Sri Lanka and West Indies at the SSC, Colombo.
